settings.calendar: US trading days (AGG or BIL), forward-fill at most 5 days

notes: The 12 picks were chosen in 2026 partly on their 2018-2026 (OOS) results and are 2026 survivors, so the walk-forward backtest overstates what an investor in 2013-2017 could have achieved: the weights are out of sample, the asset list is not.
Walk-forward weights at rebalance day t use daily returns up to t-1 only.
Daily data are aligned on US trading days (AGG or BIL trades) with forward-fill of at most 5 days, so Taiwan, India and Canada holidays carry the last close; monthly results use month ends.

NVDA, 2330.TW, SPY, ACWI and META prices in data/research/prices.csv end on 2026-10-23; the last week of October 2026 is carried flat for them (forward-fill, at most 5 days) and their order-list price is the 2026-10-23 close.
Every pick is held: stocks 3-10%, funds 1-15%, other 1-10% (the 1% floor for funds and other assets is this builder's reading of 'every pick held'; method.md fixes only the 3% stock minimum).

The headline walk-forward starts at the first quarter after all 12 picks have 126 common trading days (HYEM lists 2012-05-14), i.e. 2013-01; the estimation window grows to 3 years by 2015-05. In-sample metrics therefore cover 2013-01 to 2017-12 (60 months), not 2010-2017.
Benchmarks (GUIDE_BENCH, SIXTY_FORTY, GLOBAL_6040) are fixed mixes reset at each calendar quarter, gross of trading costs, computed from month-end prices.
EM bond funds and US assets carry zero FX by the method.md section 3 convention (USD-denominated); a local-currency fund such as EMLC would carry FX risk and is not held.
Synthetic data are used only in tests/test_build.py; nothing in this file comes from synthetic data.

adjustments.verdict: Rebalancing (net of costs) vs buy-and-hold: OOS CAGR -14.06%, OOS max drawdown +6.29% (positive = rebalanced shallower), OOS Sharpe -0.13; full CAGR -11.87%. The buy-and-hold portfolio's non-US share drifted to a minimum of 22.6%, so it would have broken the 70% rule.

optimized.method: contribution = start-of-day weight x daily USD return, summed by month and sleeve; costs and the overlay are separate lines; residual = monthly compounded return minus the sum (cross-day compounding). FX part of a local listing = weight x (USD return - local return); EM bond funds and US assets are USD-priced and have zero FX by the method.md s3 convention (EMLC-type local-currency funds would not).

optimized_overlay.method: contribution = start-of-day weight x daily USD return, summed by month and sleeve; costs and the overlay are separate lines; residual = monthly compounded return minus the sum (cross-day compounding). FX part of a local listing = weight x (USD return - local return); EM bond funds and US assets are USD-priced and have zero FX by the method.md s3 convention (EMLC-type local-currency funds would not).

settings.method: research.montecarlo.simulate, circular block bootstrap of the chosen portfolio's walk-forward monthly returns; forward drift scales the series so its geometric mean equals the weighted consensus_usd of the picks

targets.note: median, P(loss) and P(beat CPI) from the forward Monte Carlo; max drawdown and worst calendar year from the walk-forward backtest (full window, monthly USD)
